title: Auto-open priority audit table
summary: A successful audit launched from Reports now automatically selects and refreshes the generated priority CSV table when the backend completion record names that file.
reason: Operators should reach the priority results immediately after a full audit completes, without manually enabling the priority-CSV mode.
behavior_before: A completed audit could write a priority CSV while Reports remained on the full audit CSV until the operator manually selected Use latest priority CSV.
behavior_after: When a successful Reports-launched audit completes with a latest_priority_csv_path, Reports selects the priority table once and refreshes it. The full audit CSV remains available, and manual table-mode changes are preserved.
tests_added: Extended the browser Reports smoke to launch a fixture audit, emit a completed priority-CSV signal, and verify the priority table is selected and refreshed once.
manual_validation: git diff --check for all change-packet paths - passed.
rollback_plan: Remove the completed-audit priority-table selector and its per-report selection state; Reports will retain the operator-selected CSV mode after an audit completes.
notes:
Select the generated priority CSV table after a successful Reports-launched audit completes.
Track the automatically selected priority CSV so an operator can later change the table mode without it being reselected.
Assert the auto-priority table state and completion selection logic remain present.
Exercise automatic priority-table selection after a successful audit completion signal.
Refresh audit command navigation summary after automatic priority-table selection.
Refresh Reports state navigation summary after adding automatic priority-table selection state.
Refresh Reports static test navigation summary.
Refresh browser Reports smoke navigation summary.
